title: Local pseudo-coherence of the localization cone
statement: Given the data E, N and a distinguished triangle from the construction node, with E m-pseudo-coherent and N vanishing above n−1, every localization of N is m-pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Tag 066D, proof, second and third paragraphs; Tags 064S, 00EO (2), 064R

proof.text: For each i, the localization algebra B = A[f_i^{-1}] is flat by IsLocalization.flat. The private scalar_exact helper uses Module.Flat.lTensor_exact and Functor.exact_tfae to show that extension of scalars preserves finite limits; its adjunction already gives finite colimits and additivity.

An m-pseudo-coherent witness for E is also a witness at m+1: the homology map at m+1 is an isomorphism, hence epi. Apply extension of scalars to that bounded finite-free witness. The mapped complex has the same support bounds and finite-free terms (TensorProduct.instFree and the finite base-change instance). Use the natural derived homology comparison to preserve the required isomorphisms and epimorphism. This is the completely proved private pseudoCoherent_scalar helper.

Map Triangle.mk a b c by the exact scalar-extension derived functor. It remains distinguished. Its first object is (m+1)-pseudo-coherent by the preceding witness argument, and its second is m-pseudo-coherent by hlocal, transported along mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app M.

Apply the first clause of isMPseudoCoherent_of_distinguished_triangle over B. The third object is m-pseudo-coherent. Transport along mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app N to obtain the asserted termwise localization of N. The private pseudoCoherent_of_iso helper composes a witness map with an isomorphism and preserves all witness conditions.

lean.statement: theorem localization_cone_local {A : Type u₁} [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) [∀ i : Fin r, HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} (Localization.Away (f i)))] (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) (m n : ℤ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hvan : ∀ j : ℤ, n < j → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj M))) (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin r, IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))) (E N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ) (a : Q.obj E ⟶ Q.obj M) (b : Q.obj M ⟶ Q.obj N) (c : Q.obj N ⟶ (Q.obj E)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hT : Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A))) (hE : IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj E)) (hN : ∀ j : ℤ, n - 1 < j → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj N))) : ∀ i : Fin r, IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N))
